wnba.Headline: 2026 WNBA championship odds: Lynx now odds-on title favorites; Four others shorter than 10-1
wnba.Description: The Lynx remain favorites to win the WNBA championship, while the Fever are making a move on the oddsboard.

wnba.Headline: Fantasy women's hoops: Set your lineups for the fantasy finals with these players
wnba.Description: Congratulations on making it to the fantasy women's basketball finals. Now it's time to set a winning lineup!

wnba.Headline: Sources: Kanter Freedom not WNBA-eligible; arena ban TBD
wnba.Description: The WNBA has not announced any plans to ban Enes Kanter Freedom from attending future games but, according to multiple sources, the ex-NBA player will not be eligible to play in the league.

wnba.Headline: Mercury buy out DeWanna Bonner, who will seek title chance
wnba.Description: The Mercury and DeWanna Bonner have reached an agreement to buy out her contract. Once she clears waivers, the six-time All-Star will look for a chance to sign as a free agent with a playoff team.

wnba.Headline: Will Napheesa Collier's midseason return boost Lynx's WNBA title chances?
wnba.Description: After a long road back from multiple injuries, Napheesa Collier could help Minnesota peak in the WNBA playoffs.

wnba.Headline: Nelson-Ododa, Sun host the Sky
wnba.Description: Chicago Sky (15-23, 3-11 Eastern Conference) at Connecticut Sun (9-27, 2-13 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Phoenix hosts Washington following Austin's 31-point game
wnba.Description: Washington Mystics (22-15, 11-5 Eastern Conference) at Phoenix Mercury (13-24, 8-11 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Dallas hosts Portland after Bueckers' 32-point game
wnba.Description: Portland Fire (15-22, 6-11 Western Conference) at Dallas Wings (22-16, 9-9 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: WNBA players with the most 3-pointers in a single game
wnba.Description: Four WNBA players have scored a record 9 3-pointers in a single game. Check out which other players have had 3-point hot streaks.

wnba.Headline: Austin scores career-high 31, Mystics rally from 14-point deficit and beat Fire 105-100
wnba.Description: — Shakira Austin had a career-high 31 points and 10 rebounds and Georgia Amoore hit two free throws with 4.2 seconds left to help the Washington Mystics rally from a 14-point deficit and beat the Portland Fire 105-100 on Sunday night.

wnba.Headline: Kanter Freedom ejected after confrontation with Sky's Cloud
wnba.Description: Ex-NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom was ejected from Sunday's game between the Fever and the Sky after a verbal altercation with Chicago's Natasha Cloud.

wnba.Headline: Caitlin Clark scores 37 points as the Fever beat the Sky 113-90
wnba.Description: — Caitlin Clark scored 37 points and Kelsey Mitchell had 30, helping the Indiana Fever pull away from the Chicago Sky for a 113-90 victory on Sunday night.

wnba.Headline: Wilson scores 27, Young adds 21 as Aces beat short-handed Tempo 88-78

wnba.Headline: Paige Bueckers scores 18 of her 32 in 1st quarter, Wings beat Storm 92-70
wnba.Description: — Paige Bueckers scored 18 of her 32 points in the first quarter, Jessica Shepard had 11 points and 11 rebounds, and the Dallas Wings beat the Seattle Storm 92-70 on Sunday to tie the franchise's single-season wins record.
